item.title: [infoq] 阶跃星辰开放 Step 5 Preview 权重：长程 Agent 的竞争，延伸到上下文管理与训练系统
item.description: StepFun released the weights of Step 5 Preview on October 15 in BF16 and FP8 versions, published on Hugging Face and ModelScope alongside a technical blog and deployment guide. The model targets long-horizon agent tasks with a sparse MoE design: 600B total parameters, 27B activated per token, a 1M-token context window and native text and vision input. It suits developers weighing the real cost of long-running agents.

item.title: [infoq] 蚂蚁百灵开源 560B 模型 Ling-3.0-flash：0.19 美元搞定复杂工作流
item.description: Ant Group's BaiLing released Ling-3.1-flash on October 15 under an open-source license: roughly 560B total parameters with about 25B activated per token, 1M context, and weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Blended call pricing is about $0.19 per million tokens, and MXFP4 quantization for routed experts cuts the weights from 534GB to 292GB, bringing serving from 8 GPUs down to 4. Teams that want to self-host office, medical, or software-engineering workflows are the target.

item.title: [v2ex] [硬件] SSD 到底能用几年？闪迪给了个公式，顺便说说服务器上怎么看盘快不快写坏了
item.description: SanDisk published a primer explaining that most SSDs last 5–10 years, plus a formula: expected life in years = TBW ÷ (TB written per day × 365), so a 600 TBW drive at 20GB/day works out to about 82 years. The author adds server-side practice: database and log drives often write several times their capacity daily, so sizing should start from write volume, and smartctl can show an NVMe drive's Percentage Used and Data Units Written so you can log them monthly and replace before failure.

item.title: [juejin] 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
item.description: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

item.title: [infoq] Istio 1.31 拥抱 AI 智能体，却先宣布“告别”Google Cloud
item.description: Istio 1.31 lets teams run agentgateway, the Rust data plane Solo.io donated to the Linux Foundation, as a layer-7 waypoint proxy in ambient mesh via a new istio-agentgateway-waypoint GatewayClass that also handles protocols like MCP. The same release stops publishing container images and Helm charts to Google Cloud, so anyone still pulling from gcr.io/istio-release or registry.istio.io must migrate before the October 13 blackout test; those services retire in December.

item.title: [infoq] 黄仁勋谈中国 AI 公司：算力很缺，但他们就是在拼命把事情做成
item.description: In a long conversation with Lex Fridman, Jensen Huang recalled trying to reach TSMC: paging through phone books, leaving voicemails, and finally writing Morris Chang a long letter — "maybe we won't go out of business," he remembers thinking when Chang called back. He cites Chang's willingness to say "we can't do this" as part of why he chose TSMC, and says Chinese AI companies are severely constrained by compute shortages yet keep raising money and shipping. He also admits he still gets nervous

item.title: [infoq] 微软一口气致谢 23 个漏洞，背后是智谱 GLM 和一位顶级“白帽”
item.description: Microsoft's latest security update credits 23 Windows vulnerabilities to research aided by Zhipu's GLM, including one rated CVSS 9.8; the public record names the finder as "Yuki Chen using GLM from z.ai." Yuki Chen has topped Microsoft's MSRC Most Valuable Security Researcher list five times, won two Pwnie Awards, and said on October 14 that he has joined Zhipu. Bug hunting has long relied on experts reading code and tracing calls — GLM is starting to change that workflow.

item.title: [infoq] 国产 GPU 越来越多，为什么反而更难用？
item.description: An InfoQ piece argues the hard part of China's domestic AI compute has shifted from getting cards at all to running them at scale: once a cluster grows from dozens to thousands of accelerators, any weak link in networking, scheduling or fault isolation leaves cards idle. It follows Jiliu Technology, founded in 2023, and early hire Chen Wei, previously an IP networking lead at ZTE, to show the bottleneck moving from single chips to the whole system.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 做了个 macOS 原生 Emby 观影助手： TMDB 搜索找片、片单浏览、入库核对与外部播放
item.description: Emby Companion is a native macOS app that lines up curated TMDB lists — Douban Top 250, IMDb Top 250, Oscar/Cannes and other award or festival winners, Criterion and more — against your own Emby library, so you can filter what's missing, check for missing seasons or episodes, and hand playback to Infuse, SenPlayer or VidHub with progress synced back. With just a TMDB API key it also works as a standalone list browser and search tool, in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English.

item.title: [infoq] Archestra 发布 OpenAPPA，用于防范提示词注入或模型幻觉引发的数据外泄
item.description: Archestra has open-sourced OpenAPPA, a security engine that runs outside the agent's prompt and execution loop and enforces deterministic rules — data sources, access objects, trust levels, principals — from a single config file to stop data exfiltration caused by prompt injection or model hallucination. The team reports a 0% attack success rate on the Bench-Corp and AgentThreatBench suites, against 10% for Claude Code's auto mode and 31% for Microsoft FIDES.

item.description: Two-Minute Drill is a browser game that hands you the final two minutes of a real NFL game: you call run or pass based on score, clock, field position and timeouts, set receiver routes, and arrange the defense on the other side of the ball. It grades your calls by their estimated win probability rather than the outcome, uses public nflverse data, and offers a free daily scenario plus a survival mode; the UI is mostly in English.

item.title: [infoq] 拍照和翻译救不了AI眼镜？千问2218元起推新硬件，要抢现实世界里的上下文
item.description: Alibaba's Qwen launched its N1 and N1 Pro AI glasses on October 13, priced from 2,218 yuan, alongside a Bose-partnered clip-on AI earbud at 1,099 yuan. The new models drop the display in favor of voice interaction, yet the N1 Pro still packs a 50MP sensor and eye tracking at roughly 44g, with an always-on visual sensing chain drawing just 5 milliwatts. Qwen frames the hardware as a "Personal Agent" meant to give models real-world context, as China's smart-glasses shipments fell 8% year over year

item.title: [v2ex] [宽带症候群] 关于换新光猫后造成的 DNS 劫持
item.description: A V2EX user swapped in a 2.5G optical modem (F7005TV3), removed TR069 over Telnet and bridged it to a software router for PPPoE. Hours later, plaintext DNS queries were hijacked to the modem's registration page, and switching domestic traffic to DoH didn't help because the modem even intercepted the connectivity-check domains. Deleting three built-in modules — redictv3, ipredictd and appmgr — fixed it. Worth reading for anyone modding an ISP-provided ONT.

item.title: [infoq] Pi 抛出全新 Agent Harness，还把自己骂了一年的 MCP 装进了核心
item.description: Pi shipped its biggest update of the year: version 1.0 makes Code Mode and native MCP stable, alongside a new long-running agent harness called Pi Durable. Pi Durable handles message storage, task scheduling and crash recovery so an agent resumes where it left off, while Code Mode lets agents run JavaScript in a QuickJS sandbox to cut token use. The team that once publicly rejected MCP has now adopted it, marking Pi's move from a terminal coding agent toward agent infrastructure.
